> 第六章 第一次对战（第1页）
他一直由早上走到下午，足足走了六七个时辰，他不断地超越了一座座的大山，遇到了不少小妖兽，不过这些对于现在的冯斗来说，根本就不算什么了。
只能消耗点了冯斗的一点时间而已，时间对于他来说，根本就不算什么，当然正是因为这样做才是冯斗真正需要的一切。
因为以冯斗现在最需要的东西就是战斗经验，一直以来冯斗都没有打开天灵盖，所以更加谈不上什么战斗经验可言啦！
经过大大小小几十场战斗之后，冯斗已经脱掉了身上的稚嫩，更加多一份成熟和稳重，然而冯斗也在战斗之中得到了四枚一星魔核。
与此同时一星魔兽对于冯斗来说，还是非常之重要的，冯斗通过吸收魔核上的能量，能够提升自己的灵气，经过吸收这四枚魔核的能量之后，他现在已经突破到了灵动三段中期，而且他觉得自己现在在灵动三段越来越稳定。
冯斗心里想：现在越来越难提升自己的实力，这一下子不是一个办法啊！
他此时吃了一块妖兽肉，他心里想：这里应该还是算是妖兽山的外围，以我现在的修为，进入妖兽山内围，必死无疑，还不如在外围好好地锻炼一下。
同时冯斗觉得自己的空间方面的修为也有所提升，他隐隐觉得已经开始控制得周围一丈之内空间流动，但是短短的瞬间，但是已经足够了，有时间与敌人对抗起来，那边就是短暂的瞬间时间，也是完全可以做到出奇制胜的作用。
高手之间的斗战，可能就是失之毫毛，差之千里的。
冯斗觉得自己应该更加加强对于空间力的修炼，可能他还不知道的事情，能够修炼出空间力的人，就算是十万之中，也不一定有一个人能够修炼出来的。
不知道是冯斗是好运，还是不幸运呢？
因为修炼空间力的人十之八九都是难于成功的，修炼空间力注定是一条非常之艰辛和遥远的道路，很多人就算是因为修炼时间过长，同时修炼空间力不单单需要天赋，同时还是需要更加多机遇和修炼资源！
这一些都是冯斗所无知道的，一旦他知道了，他会因此而选择放弃修炼空间力，转投其他方面呢？
自古以来不乏天赋英才因为得知空间力修炼所需要的东西，最后还是决定放弃了。
冯斗此时不断地吸收了来自魔核的能力之后，他将体内的灵气不断地运行，可是现在他觉得自己需要不断地吸收大量的能力，只有这样下去，才能够不断地提高自己的能力。
冯斗这时不断地修炼，以此同时，他隐隐地在燕京遗物之中，找到一部关于炼药的书籍，他发觉在修炼范围之内，真正依靠找魔核还是远远不够的。
他得知道一件东西可以瞬间帮助到他提升自己的实力，那就是吃用丹药，在燕京的书籍之中记录着有人在渡过仙劫时，服用一颗丹药，直接扛过了仙劫的仙雷。
同样也是因为这样，在整个灵修界来说，丹药师却是非常之吃香的职业，曾经一个风云一时的强者，却是因为得罪了一名君级丹药师，结果引起了不必要的显然大波。
这位君级丹药师请动了差不多十位同等级的强者围攻杜绝这位风云一时的强者，结果这位强者最后只能付出了沉重的代价，不但是消耗了大量的资源同时自废一根手臂才将整件事平定下来了。
这件事一下子就让丹药师的地位推到历史的最高位，一下子就让丹药师成为整个灵修界的香饽饽。
从此之后，就算是丹药师本身修为并不是太高，但是他的影响力却要远远地超过了一般超强者，乃至一些超强者为了能够得到提升实力，不惜为之而付出一切。正是因为这样，冯斗准备开始进入这块香饽饽！

> Chapter 6 The first battle (page 1)
He walked from morning to afternoon for a full six or seven hours. He continued to surpass mountains one after another and encountered many small monsters, but these were nothing to Feng Dou now.
It only consumes a little bit of Feng Dou's time. Time is nothing to him. Of course, it is precisely because doing this is all Feng Dou really needs.
Because what Feng Dou needs most now is combat experience. Feng Dou has never opened the Tianling Cap, so there is no combat experience at all!
After dozens of battles, large and small, Feng Dou had shed his immaturity and became more mature and steady. However, Feng Dou also obtained four one-star magic cores during the battle.
At the same time, the one-star magic beast is still very important to Feng Dou. Feng Dou can improve his spiritual energy by absorbing the energy from the magic core. After absorbing the energy of these four magic cores, he has now broken through to the middle of the third level of agility, and he feels that he is becoming more and more stable in the third level of agility.
Feng Dou thought to himself: It is getting harder and harder to improve one's strength now, and now there is no solution!
He ate a piece of monster meat at this time, and he thought to himself: This should still be regarded as the outside of Monster Mountain. With my current cultivation level, if I enter the inner circle of Monster Mountain, I will definitely die, so I might as well exercise on the outside.
At the same time, Feng Dou felt that his space cultivation had also improved. He vaguely felt that he had begun to control the flow of space within a foot around him, but it was only a short moment, but it was enough. He had time to confront the enemy. Even in a short moment, he could completely achieve a surprise victory.
In a battle between masters, the difference may be a hair's breadth or a thousand miles.
Feng Dou felt that he should strengthen his training in spatial power. Maybe he didn't know something yet. Even among a hundred thousand people who can cultivate spatial power, not even one person may be able to do it.
I wonder if Feng Dou is lucky or unlucky?
Because nine out of ten people who practice space power will have difficulty succeeding. Cultivating space power is destined to be a very difficult and long road. Many people practice space power because the training time is too long. At the same time, practicing space power not only requires talent, but also requires more opportunities and training resources!
These are things Feng Dou doesn't know. Once he knows, will he choose to give up practicing space power and switch to other fields?
Since ancient times, there have been many talented people who finally decided to give up after learning what was needed to practice spatial power.
After Feng Dou continued to absorb the abilities from the magic core, he continued to circulate the spiritual energy in his body, but now he felt that he needed to continuously absorb a large amount of abilities. Only in this way can he continue to improve his abilities.
Feng Dou continued to practice at this time. At the same time, he faintly found a book on refining medicine among the relics of Yanjing. He found that within the scope of practice, it was not enough to truly rely on finding the magic core.
He had to know that one thing could instantly help him improve his strength, and that was taking pills. In Yanjing's books, it was recorded that someone took a pill when they were going through the Immortal Tribulation, and they directly withstood the Immortal Tribulation's Immortal Thunder.
It is also because of this that in the entire spiritual world, the alchemist is a very popular profession. A once powerful man who was once a powerful man offended a king-level alchemist, which caused an unnecessary and obvious disturbance.
This king-level alchemist invited almost ten strong men of the same level to besiege and eliminate this powerful man. As a result, this strong man had to pay a heavy price in the end. He not only consumed a lot of resources but also destroyed an arm to settle the whole matter.
This incident suddenly pushed the status of the alchemist to the highest position in history, and suddenly made the alchemist a favorite in the entire spiritual world.
From then on, even if the alchemist's own cultivation level was not too high, his influence far exceeded that of ordinary superpowers, and some superpowers even sacrificed everything in order to improve their strength. It is precisely because of this that Feng Dou is ready to enter this hot cake!
